na5bdf3a0a1f.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
na5bdf3a0a1f.x: RySS was incorporated in October 2014; ZBNF was launched in Andhra Pradesh in 2016.

ne4f76a07dea.s: Under Andhra Pradesh's El Nino action plan (July 2026), how many Mobile Rythu Bazaars were provided per district?
ne4f76a07dea.x: The plan provided one Mobile Rythu Bazaar per district, along with a control room and crop-shift advisories through Rythu Seva Kendras.

nfc975a51340.s:
Consider the following statements about Bondalu paddy:
1. In December 2019, Kakinada farmers were advised to stop growing it.
2. Its earlier buyer State, Karnataka, had begun growing it itself.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
nfc975a51340.x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is wrong: the earlier buyer that began growing Bondalu itself was Kerala.

n02e524c1313.s:
Consider the following statements about the 11 crops targeted for productivity improvement under the 17 growth engines of Swarna Andhra @2047:
1. Sunflower and sesamum are included.
2. Sugarcane is included.
3. Redgram is included.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
n02e524c1313.x: The 11 crops include redgram, sunflower and sesamum among others; sugarcane is not in the list.

n387e543b735.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched with Andhra Pradesh's 2019 Livestock Census State rank?
n387e543b735.x: Sheep ranked second; cattle ranked fourteenth, goat eleventh and buffalo sixth.

n687d4fbf48d.s:
Consider the following statements about Andhra Pradesh's cultivated area as per NITI Aayog (2020-21):
1. It was 10.1 million hectares.
2. It was about 37% of the State's geographical area.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
n687d4fbf48d.x: NITI Aayog reported 10.1 million hectares of cultivated area, equal to about 37% of the geographical area.

n2706b011c0b.s:
Consider the following statements about oil palm in Andhra Pradesh:
1. Andhra Pradesh ranks first in India in oil-palm area.
2. Andhra Pradesh accounts for 48% of India's oil-palm area.
3. Andhra Pradesh also leads India in oil-palm productivity.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
n2706b011c0b.x: All three are correct: AP holds 48% of India's oil-palm area (2.49 lakh ha) and leads in area, production and productivity.

n466b408118f.s:
Consider the following statements about the AP Micro Irrigation Project (APMIP):
1. It has been in operation since 2003-04.
2. Rayalaseema accounts for 71 per cent of its coverage.
3. It covers 13.49 lakh acres.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
n466b408118f.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is wrong: APMIP covers 37.90 lakh acres; 13.49 lakh is the number of farmers.

n7335eb76822.s:
Consider the following statements about aquaculture in Andhra Pradesh:
1. It is regarded as the core of the State's Blue Economy.
2. Its markets are completely independent of foreign demand.
3. It supports over five lakh families.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
n7335eb76822.x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. Statement 2 is wrong: AP aquaculture depends on foreign markets, including the US.

ne4e313c9df2.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the agro-climatic zones of Andhra Pradesh?
o: Andhra Pradesh has six agro-climatic zones
They are the same as the six public employment zones under Article 371-D
They include the Scarce Rainfall Zone
They include the High Altitude and Tribal Areas Zone
ne4e313c9df2.x: The Article 371-D zones are administrative zones for public employment, unrelated to the six agro-climatic zones.

n911eee8965a.s: The headquarters of the Scarce Rainfall Zone of Andhra Pradesh is at:
n911eee8965a.x: The Scarce Rainfall Zone is headquartered at Nandyal; Maruteru is the Godavari Zone HQ and Lam (Guntur) the Krishna Zone HQ.

n633235a542f.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about cooperative laws and policy?
o: The Cooperative Societies Act, 1912 allowed non-credit societies
The 97th Constitutional Amendment was made in 2011
The National Cooperative Policy was announced in 2011
The AP Cooperative Societies Act was enacted in 1964
n633235a542f.x: The National Cooperative Policy came in 2002; 2011 is the year of the 97th Amendment.

n76132d1023a.s: India's about 8.5 lakh cooperative societies have approximately how many members?
n76132d1023a.x: India has about 8.5 lakh cooperatives with over 30 crore members.

n0436db5b6aa.s: PACS in how many blocks of Andhra Pradesh are eligible for NCDC equity grants as FPOs?
n0436db5b6aa.x: PACS in 207 blocks are eligible for NCDC equity grants as FPOs, with APCOB acting as the CBBO.

naee08236890.s: Model bye-laws permit PACS to undertake more than how many non-credit activities?
naee08236890.x: Model bye-laws allow PACS to take up more than 25 non-credit activities.

ne213dee09f5.s: Which of the following pairs about PACS in Andhra Pradesh is correctly matched?
ne213dee09f5.x: 2,037 PACS are being computerised; 1,490 were assigned to fertilizer companies and 1,553 completed pre-migration.

nf2b788b339a.s: Tribhuvan Sahakari University at IRMA, Anand, is known as:
o: India's first national cooperative exports company
An urban cooperative bank development body
nf2b788b339a.x: Tribhuvan Sahakari University is India's first national cooperative university; NUCFDC is the urban cooperative bank body.

new.s: According to the Agriculture Census 2015-16, the average operational holding in Andhra Pradesh was:
new.x: AP's average holding was 0.94 ha against India's 1.08 ha.

new.s: Which class of operational holdings dominates, accounting for 86.21% of holdings nationally?
new.x: Small and marginal holdings (0-2 ha) dominate, at 86.21% nationally.

new.s: The net sown area of Andhra Pradesh in 2024-25 was what share of its geographical area?
new.x: NSA was 59.14 lakh ha = 36.29% in 2024-25; 30.40% was the drought year 2023-24 and 37% is NITI Aayog's cultivated-area figure.

new.s: Who is the Chairman of the Andhra Pradesh State Agriculture Mission constituted in July 2019?
new.x: Under G.O.Ms.No.57 (1 July 2019), the Chief Minister chairs the AP State Agriculture Mission.

new.s: The Vice-Chairman of the AP State Agriculture Mission (2019), a farmer and aquaculturist, was:
new.x: M.V.S. Nagi Reddy, a farmer and aquaculturist, was made Vice-Chairman of the Mission.

new.s: K. Atchannaidu presented Andhra Pradesh's Agriculture and Allied Budget 2026-27 for the:
new.x: The ~Rs 53,753 crore 2026-27 agriculture budget was his third.

new.s: In 2021-22, Andhra Pradesh's rice yield of 3,392 kg/ha compared with a national average of:
new.x: India's average was 2,798 kg/ha in 2021-22; 3,846 vs 2,844 are the 2022-23 figures.

new.s: In 2022-23 (third advance estimates), Andhra Pradesh's rice yield was:
new.x: AP's rice yield was 3,846 kg/ha in 2022-23, above India's 2,844 kg/ha.

new.s: By 19 August of Kharif 2026, about what share of the normal area had been sown in Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Only about 61% of the normal area was sown, with all 28 districts in rainfall deficit.

new.s: In 2024-25, Andhra Pradesh's paddy output of 127.15 lakh tonnes included a Kharif output of:
new.x: Kharif paddy was 78.79 lakh t and rabi 48.36 lakh t.

new.s: Which district of Andhra Pradesh is associated mainly with groundnut?
new.x: Anantapuramu, in the scarce rainfall region, is the groundnut district.

new.s: Kurnool and YSR Kadapa districts are associated with which crop?
new.x: Kurnool and YSR Kadapa are onion districts.

new.s: Guntur district is associated mainly with which crop?
new.x: Guntur is the chillies district and also hosts the Tobacco Board of India.

new.s: Which cropping-pattern change has taken place in the Godavari delta?
o: Cotton land converted to oil palm
new.x: Paddy lands in the Godavari delta have been converted to aquaculture.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's entire coffee production comes from:
new.x: AP ranks 4th in coffee and 100% of it comes from Araku Valley.

new.s: Semen laboratories under the National Livestock Mission in Andhra Pradesh are located at:
new.x: The NLM semen laboratories are at Kurnool and Visakhapatnam.

new.s: Annadata Sukhibhava-PM Kisan assistance is paid in how many instalments a year?
new.x: It is paid in 3 instalments: Kharif Rs 7,000, Rabi Rs 7,000 and Summer Rs 6,000.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about Annadata Sukhibhava-PM Kisan:
1. It provides Rs 20,000 per farmer family per year.
2. CCRC-holding tenants are eligible.
3. The Rabi instalment is Rs 6,000.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is wrong: the Rabi instalment is Rs 7,000; Rs 6,000 is the Summer instalment.

new.s: From which season did Andhra Pradesh rejoin PMFBY?
new.x: AP rejoined PMFBY from Kharif 2022 after running Dr YSR Free Crop Insurance.

new.s: Dr YSR Free Crop Insurance was introduced in Andhra Pradesh from:
new.x: Dr YSR Free Crop Insurance started from Kharif 2019; AP rejoined PMFBY from Kharif 2022.

new.s: How many hours of free daytime power do farm pump-sets get in Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: 22.36 lakh pump sets get 9 hours of free daytime power.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Panta Sanjeevani – Sheep and goat units
new.x: Pasu Bhima Padhakam is livestock insurance; Jala Yagnam is irrigation, Jeeva Kranthi sheep and goat units, Panta Sanjeevani farm ponds.

new.s: Jala Yagnam (2004-09) in Andhra Pradesh was associated with:
new.x: Jala Yagnam covered 52 major and medium irrigation projects.

new.s: The farmers' Integrated Call Centre (toll-free 155251) in Andhra Pradesh is located at:
new.x: The Integrated Call Centre, set up in May 2020, is at Gannavaram, along with the RBK Channel and Studio.

new.s: The toll-free number of the farmers' Integrated Call Centre in Andhra Pradesh is:
new.x: The Integrated Call Centre's toll-free number is 155251; 1962 is the animal-husbandry app.

new.s: The Telugu farm monthly 'Vyavasayam' is published by:
new.x: Vyavasayam is published by ANGRAU.

new.s: ATMA prepares which plan for its district?
new.x: ATMA, a district-level autonomous body, prepares the SREP.

new.s: Crop Cultivator Rights Cards have been issued in Andhra Pradesh since:
new.x: CCRCs under the AP Crop Cultivator Rights Act, 2019 are issued from 2 October 2019.

new.s: In APCNF, Beejamrutham is used for:
new.x: Beejamrutham is seed treatment; mulching and 365-day green cover are separate practices.

new.s: Ghanajeevamrutham in natural farming is:
new.x: Ghanajeevamrutham is the solid form of the bio-fertiliser Jeevamrutham.

new.s: Which crops are used as trap crops under APCNF?
new.x: Marigold and castor are used as trap crops.

new.s: APCNF currently covers about how many farmers?
new.x: APCNF covers 10.20 lakh farmers on 4.89 lakh ha; 41 lakh is the 2028-29 target.

new.s: By when does APCNF aim to cover all gram panchayats of Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: The target is all GPs by 2026-27; 2047 is the '100% natural farming state' goal.

new.s: The ISHA Foundation awards to four AP natural farmers (28 July 2024) were presented at:
new.x: They were presented at the Paddy and Food Mahotsav at Sripuram, Vellore.

new.s: Ranjith Kumar, an AP natural farmer honoured by the ISHA Foundation in 2024, is from which district?
new.x: Ranjith Kumar is from Krishna; G. Ramu is from West Godavari.

new.s: Which institution has given a loan for expanding APCNF?
new.x: KfW, the German development bank, gave a loan; Azim Premji Foundation gives technical support grants.

new.s: The Azim Premji Foundation supports APCNF through:
new.x: Azim Premji Foundation provides technical support grants; KfW gives the loan.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about NMNF and PKVY:
1. NMNF promotes organic farming.
2. PKVY clusters are certified under PGS-India.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statement 1 is wrong: NMNF is natural farming; PKVY is organic farming certified under PGS-India.

new.s: The Gulbenkian Prize for Humanity 2024, shared by APCNF, was announced at:
new.x: It was announced in Lisbon on 11 July 2024; Bastad hosted the Food Planet Prize 2026.

new.s: In which of the following crops does Andhra Pradesh rank first in productivity?
new.x: AP is 1st in papaya productivity; it is 2nd in mango, sweet orange and turmeric.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh ranks first in India in fruits, with a share of:
new.x: AP is 1st in fruits with 15.6% of India's output.

new.s: In 2025-26, Andhra Pradesh ranked ____ in India in chillies.
new.x: AP ranked 2nd in chillies in 2025-26.

new.s: Under NMEO-OP (2021), India's oil-palm area is to be raised to:
new.x: NMEO-OP adds 6.5 lakh ha to reach 10 lakh ha.

new.s:
Arrange the following oil missions in chronological order:
1. NMOOP
2. Oilseeds Technology Mission
3. NMEO-OP
new.x: Oilseeds Technology Mission (1986), NMOOP (2014), NMEO-OP (2021).

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the National Horticulture Mission?
o: It covers selected districts of 18 States and 5 UTs
It covers the North-Eastern and Himalayan States
Post-harvest management is one of its objectives
new.x: NE and Himalayan States are not under NHM; they have a separate mission (HMNEH).

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's horticulture GVA grew by about what in 2024-25?
new.x: Horticulture GVA (Rs 1,52,950 crore) grew 21% in 2024-25.

new.s: As per the White Paper on Agriculture and allied sectors (Dec 2018), Andhra Pradesh ranked ____ in milk.
new.x: The White Paper put AP 5th in milk, 1st in poultry, 2nd in eggs and 4th in meat.

new.s: The Dec 2018 White Paper on Agriculture and allied sectors named which two sectors as growth engines?
new.x: It identified livestock and horticulture as growth engines.

new.s: The first-ever Credit Guarantee Scheme for the livestock sector (2023) was launched by:
new.x: DAHD launched it under AHIDF with a Rs 750 crore fund.

new.s: How many mobile veterinary clinics, at 2 per constituency, are provided in Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: There are 340 clinics (2 per constituency); 175 came in Phase 1 on 19 May 2022.

new.s: In 2024-25, Andhra Pradesh ranked ____ in India in meat production.
new.x: AP was 4th in meat (11.37 lakh t), 1st in eggs and 7th in milk.

new.s: India holds about what share of the world's buffalo population?
new.x: India has 59.29% of the world's buffaloes and 19.46% of its cattle.

new.s: In 2017-18, inland fisheries accounted for about what share of Andhra Pradesh's fish production?
new.x: Inland fisheries dominate at about 82%; marine is about 18%.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh accounts for about what share of India's fish production?
new.x: AP produces about 29-30% of India's fish (55.39 lakh t in 2024-25).

new.s: The older official length of Andhra Pradesh's coastline, revised to 1,053 km in APSES 2025-26, was:
new.x: The older figure was 974 km; APSES 2025-26 gives 1,053 km.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's share of India's shrimp exports in 2024-25 was about:
new.x: AP had 31% of shrimp exports; 36% is seafood export value (2018-19) and 75% cultured-shrimp exports.

new.s: Which of the following is an arm of MPEDA?
new.x: RGCA, NETFISH and NaCSA are MPEDA's arms.

new.s: The corpus of the Fisheries and Aquaculture Infrastructure Development Fund (FIDF) is:
new.x: FIDF corpus is Rs 7,522 crore; Rs 20,050 crore is PMMSY and Rs 6,000 crore PM-MKSSY.

new.s: Which pair about fishing-ban relief per family in Andhra Pradesh is correctly matched?
new.x: Relief was Rs 4,000 before 2019-20, Rs 10,000 from 2019-20 and Rs 20,000 from 2024-25.

new.s: The aqua-power tariff for farms above 10 acres or outside notified aqua zones in Andhra Pradesh is:
new.x: Bigger farms or those outside zones pay Rs 3.85; Rs 1.50 applies up to 10 acres inside zones.

new.s: Undivided Andhra Pradesh had how many agro-climatic zones under NARP?
new.x: Undivided AP had 7 zones, including North and Southern Telangana; residual AP has six.

new.s: In undivided Andhra Pradesh, the Krishna and Godavari areas formed:
o: Part of the North Coastal zone
Part of the Scarce Rainfall zone
new.x: Krishna and Godavari formed a single Krishna-Godavari zone before bifurcation.

new.s: SPS Nellore district belongs to which agro-climatic zone of Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: The Southern Zone covers Chittoor, YSR Kadapa and SPS Nellore; Nellore is not in the Krishna Zone.

new.s: The Krishna agro-climatic zone of Andhra Pradesh comprises:
new.x: The Krishna Zone covers Krishna, Guntur and Prakasam districts.

new.s: Laterite soils are characteristic of which agro-climatic zone of Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: The North Coastal Zone has high rainfall and laterite soils.

new.s: The ANGRAU Regional Agricultural Research Station of the North Coastal Zone is at:
new.x: Anakapalle is the North Coastal RARS; Chintapalle serves the High Altitude and Tribal Zone.

new.s: Chintapalle is the Regional Agricultural Research Station of which zone?
new.x: Chintapalle is the RARS of the High Altitude and Tribal Areas Zone.

new.s: The Regional Agricultural Research Station of the Godavari Zone is at:
new.x: The Godavari Zone RARS is Maruteru, not Rajahmundry.

new.s: Annual rainfall in the Scarce Rainfall Zone of Andhra Pradesh is about:
new.x: The Scarce Rainfall Zone gets the lowest rainfall, 500-750 mm; the High Altitude and Tribal Zone gets above 1,400 mm.

new.s: The normal annual rainfall of Andhra Pradesh, against which 2024-25 recorded 960.3 mm, is:
new.x: Normal rainfall is 860.0 mm, so 960.3 mm was an 11.7% excess.

new.s: In Kharif 2026, how many districts of Andhra Pradesh were in rainfall deficit?
new.x: All 28 districts were in deficit; Annamayya, Prakasam, Chittoor, Markapuram and Visakhapatnam were worst hit.

new.s: In the Sengupta and Sdasyuk (1968) scheme, the macro agricultural regions were based on:
new.x: Macro regions were based on climate, meso on physiography and micro on crop combinations.

new.s: In zone-based contingency crop planning, agro-climatic zones are used mainly to:
new.x: Zones decide region-specific interventions; district contingency plans are prepared by ICAR-CRIDA.

new.s: The Supreme Court struck down Part IXB of the Constitution in its application to:
new.x: Part IXB was struck down for State cooperatives and survives only for multi-State societies.

new.s: The AP Cooperative Tribunal exercises original jurisdiction over disputes under the:
new.x: It has original jurisdiction under the MACS Act, 1995 and hears appeals under the 1964 Act.

new.s: Which Act started the cooperative movement in India?
new.x: The 1904 Act started the movement; the 1912 Act allowed non-credit societies.

new.s: The APCCADB was merged into APCOB with effect from:
new.x: APCCADB merged into APCOB from 30 April 1994 under the Single Window Act, 1994.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh, the only State to integrate short-term and long-term cooperative credit, did so from:
new.x: AP integrated the two from 1986; primary agricultural development banks were abolished in 1987.

new.s: Nationally, long-term investment credit in the cooperative sector is given by:
new.x: Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (ARDBs) give long-term investment credit.

new.s: How many District Cooperative Central Banks are there in Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: AP has 13 DCCBs with 442 branches; APCOB has 18 branches.

new.s: How many Labour Contract Cooperative Societies were being wound up in Andhra Pradesh in 2024-25?
new.x: 1,756 Labour Contract societies and 210 Joint Farming societies were being wound up.

new.s: Political capture of cooperative boards mainly feeds which problem?
new.x: Boards shield politically connected defaulters, which feeds overdues.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about problems of cooperatives:
1. About one-third of registered PACS are inactive as per state audits.
2. Many cooperatives lack professional management and digital capacity.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Both are correct: about one-third of PACS are idle, and capacity gaps in management and digital skills persist.

new.s: The committee whose work led to the setting up of NABARD was headed by:
new.x: The B. Sivaraman committee led to NABARD.

new.s: In which year was the Prakash Bakshi Expert Committee on short-term cooperative credit structure set up?
new.x: The Bakshi Committee was in 2013; the Vaidyanathan Task Force was in 2004.

new.s: Under the decentralised grain storage plan (Sep 2026), the margin money for PACS was cut from 20% to:
new.x: Margin money fell from 20% to 10%, and the AMI subsidy rose to 33.33%.

new.s: By July 2026, grain-storage godowns had been completed in how many PACS of Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Godowns were completed in 313 PACS with over 1.80 LMT capacity.

new.s: How many PACS of Andhra Pradesh were converted into PM Kisan Samruddhi Kendras?
new.x: 1,246 of the 1,490 PACS assigned to fertilizer companies became PM Kisan Samruddhi Kendras.
